question: dame el volumen liquidado en euros de cada mes junto con la diferencia respecto al mes anterior, ordenado por mes
sql:
SELECT
  month_name,
  net_eur_minor,
  net_eur_minor - LAG(net_eur_minor) OVER (ORDER BY month_name) AS diferencia_con_mes_anterior
FROM (
  SELECT
    d.month_name,
    d.iso_year,
    d.month,
    SUM(s.net_eur_minor) AS net_eur_minor
  FROM fact_settlement_batch s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.settlement_date = d.full_date
  GROUP BY
    d.month_name,
    d.iso_year,
    d.month
) AS monthly_data
ORDER BY
  iso_year,
  month
